question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

6, 8, 13, 15, 27, 29, 55, 57, ?
solution:
**Logic : **

 
• Alternately (2) is added.
 
• Alternately multiplied by (2) along with subtraction of (3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a526b2c54c4f7b24694bd70024088515c15e9a8c51222e047e9c21c928631aed.png] 

Hence, **"111"** is the correct answer.
